a_module_marked_unchanged_that_depends_o.criterion: A module marked unchanged that in fact depends on an equity-only assumption.
a_module_marked_unchanged_that_depends_o.evidence: Named candidates for attack are in section 17: the factor covariance, which needs a spread input for a DTS loading to mean anything; the hedge algebra, whose instrument betas are the weakest link; and the cross-sectional standardization, which takes its cross-section over the names priced on the row's own date. The last one is not a theory: EFB's hedge was one session stale for that reason, with the measurements stored in tests/test_hedge_vintage.py.

an_open_question_with_no_efb_evidence_be.criterion: An open question with no EFB evidence behind it.
an_open_question_with_no_efb_evidence_be.evidence: Section 14 carries 13 questions and every one names a stored EFB result with its file. The count of citations that resolve to a file in the repository is 37 of 37, asserted by tests/test_e13_design_note.py::test_every_citation_resolves_to_a_stored_file.

notes: Document-only sprint: no model code, no new panel, no new live data, and no change to any E1 to E12 artifact, criterion or stored number.
The design note cites no credit data, because none was available. Its credit statements are design statements or predictions, and the note says so where the distinction matters.
F13.1 is a statement about the repository and the document together, so it is checked by a test that enumerates the repository rather than claimed: 86 modules found, 86 in the map.
One module was missing from the map when the test first ran (efb/models/__init__.py). It is recorded here because the test, not a reviewer, found it.
